title: Joining a Club
passage:
I have been so bored these days. I think I need a new hobby.

Same here. Maybe we should join a club.

Oh, that sounds lovely. But what clubs does our school offer?

Our school provides many clubs to choose from. In my opinion, the best ones are the Science Club, the Art Club, the Drama Club, and the Debate Team.

There are so many to consider. How can you select just one?

That's the great thing about clubs. You can be a member of more than one if you want to.

Really? But what about their meetings?

Most of them meet on different weekdays, so you can see which one you like most.

I think I am going to join the club that lets me give speeches and discuss things like international events or climate change.

Maybe they will elect you to be the club president.

I want to join the Science Club. I have always wanted to invent something new.

Plus, I hear that they also build robots.
